current_question.status: Research direction, not an announced result
current_question.title: When does an encounter change the next choice?
current_question.body: Our next integration question is whether qualified consequence evidence changes a later choice inside an existing continuing project. An isolated laboratory result is not automatically a capability of Luna.
current_question.scrutiny: Useful scrutiny would challenge the evidence attribution, the comparison with simpler mechanisms, or what the later choice would actually establish.

changes.title: A clearer name and a visible publication record
changes.body: Luna is expanded as Locus of Unified Noetic Agency. This edition adds a current research question, publication history, a public feed, and separate dates for editorial coverage, research review, and native records. Earlier dated notes retain their original scope. No new scientific result is introduced by this editorial update.
